items.name: The Mask
items.description:
Begin with clean, dry skin. Leave for at least an hour but also can be left for up to 4. Wash with room temperature water and continue with your own ritual or use our face butter or face oil for some moisture.
A clean, botanical formula made in small batches — part of The Gypsi ritual.

items.name: The Face Oil
items.description: A blend of exotic oils that are super anti-oxidant, anti-aging, boosts collagen production and firms skin.

items.name: The Face Butter
items.description: A deeply moisturizing face butter that melts into skin, leaving it soft, smooth, and radiant. Made with rich botanical butters and oils to moisturize, restore, and protect. Melt in hands and apply on clean face, neck, chest and hands for best results. Can also be used as a moisturizing mask.
